author: Zintenka
body:
An experimental TNT based TDM. Don't worry, TNT doesnt blow up blocks. And you will have to buy it with gold nuggets. 

Iron gives you a full iron set. 

Endstone gives you 16 xp bottles. 

You cant build across the void, you will have to icarus across it. Kill peeps to get nuggets!

Fall damage is disabled.

There is enchanting and villager shops. BTW, for those of you who don't know what an icarus is, it is a player launching cannon.

Now without further Adieu, I give you! TNT Warz! (Map size updated)




Imgur: Here

Download: Here

YML: Here
